title: Rebuild an Isekai Kingdom [5.0]
description:
[Working Events!] [IS/AC] You are summoned to become the ruler of a fantasy kingdom with a fiery princess who seems to think you have stolen the throne! Will you rebuild the kingdom and win over her heart?


(Very) Loosely based on How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom. I toned down some details so it won't get too complex for the AI but still make the story enjoyable.

TO TRIGGER EVENTS*:
-To advance the story and unfold another crisis, simply make a 'Do' action that includes the words 'advance the story'

*Not very immersive I know, but as a certain Todd said: iT jUsT WOrkS. You can edit the action after triggering the events.

Suitable for:
-Strategy/military nerds
-Visual novel players
-Weirdos who want to explain modern technology/history to medieval people
-All of the above


Thanks @LewdLeah for the amazing IS/AC!
prompt:
The day began like any other—classes, assignments, the humdrum of a college student's life. But in an instant, everything changed. In a blink of an eye, you found yourself standing in a grand, opulent hall unlike anything you'd ever seen. You widen your eyes as you see a man sitting on a throne, his presence commanded the room—a king.

"Welcome to Fresdia, hero from another world," The king says as he rises from his throne, his voice carrying the weight of the realm. "I am King Arbar of Fresdia, and I have summoned you here in our time of greatest need." Over the next hours, the king and his advisors talked about the dire situation of Fresdia after the Cotton Famine, urging you to draft a plan to save the kingdom using your otherworldly knowledge.

In the following days, you started learning about this kingdom and this world, studying its history and people. King Arbar Fresdia watched in awe as you described your plans to rebuild the kingdom based on your understanding of this world and your modern knowledge as a university student. Recognizing that you were the best fit to save the kingdom, he made a momentous decision.

In a grand ceremony attended by the kingdom's royal advisors and nobles, King Arbar stood before his throne, his voice carrying the weight of history. "This kingdom has found new hope under the guidance of one who sees beyond our struggles. I, Arbar Fresdia, hereby abdicate the throne in favor of ${Are you a King or a Queen?} ${Your first name?} ${Your last name?}, the hero from another world!"

A few days later, Princess Rista Fresdia, who was serving on the field, rushed back to the capital upon receiving the news of her father's abdication. As she catches glimpse of her father in the Royal Garden, she decides to confront him. "Father, what madness is this? D-Did you seriously give our kingdom away to a stranger from another world?" - Be specific, descriptive, and creative.

- Avoid repetition, summarization. 
- Generally use second person (like this: 'He looks at you.'). But use third person if that's what the story seems to follow.

cardPool.value:
{A powerful group of marauders and raiders in the western isles. They are master seafarers and fighters. They love to pillage, no matter who they're pillaging.

They have caused chaos for both the demons and the Holy Alliance. They worship the Storm God and wish to die in combat so their soul can arrive at the Storm Land.

They can travel south in rare cases. In unlucky cases, they can raid your coastal cities. But they can also raid your enemies instead, as long as they catch them near the coasts.

The islanders are, similar to demons, led by powerful individuals who built their own armies and ships. Because of this nature, some can be convinced to fight for you... for a price. They can be traded with (for furs and high-quality ships).

As a side faction, they do not have significant impact on the story. You can still interact with them, though.}

cardPool.title: Demons
cardPool.description:
A coalition of demons have risen in the north. They are led by different Demon Generals who act independently from each other but share a common goal: to conquer the world for demonkind.

In response to this, many kingdoms have formed a united Holy Alliance to fight against the demons. The Holy Alliance is led by the young Empress Tirasa - sovereign of the Holy Empire.

However, there are still a few kingdoms who refused to join the Holy Alliance such as Fresdia and a couple of small kingdoms in the east.

A powerful group of marauders and raiders in the western isles. They are master seafarers and fighters. They love to pillage, no matter who they're pillaging.

They have caused chaos for both the demons and the Holy Alliance. They worship the Storm God and wish to die in combat so their soul can arrive at the Storm Land.

They can travel south in rare cases. In unlucky cases, they can raid your coastal cities. But they can also raid your enemies instead, as long as they catch them near the coasts.

The islanders are, similar to demons, led by powerful individuals who built their own armies and ships. Because of this nature, some can be convinced to fight for you... for a price. They can be traded with (for furs and high-quality ships).

As a side faction, they do not have significant impact on the story. You can still interact with them, though.

cardPool.title: Second crisis: Declaration of war from Sardoa (CR2)
cardPool.value:
When triggered: The Kingdom of Sardoa will declare war against Fresdia, thinking they can take advantage of the change in power. They seek to annex Fresdia to triple their territory.

When triggered, the invading force from Sardoa will march around the Jagged Mountains, allowing you some time to react. The army will consist of mostly infantry and siege equipments, with a few thousands elite mages who can cast dangerous spells. The invading force is led by Vamas Estoro.

cardPool.title: Demons
cardPool.value:
A coalition of demons have risen in the north. They are led by different Demon Generals who act independently from each other but share a common goal: to conquer the world for demonkind.

In response to this, many kingdoms have formed a united Holy Alliance to fight against the demons. The Holy Alliance is led by the young Empress Tirasa - sovereign of the Holy Empire.

However, there are still a few kingdoms who refused to join the Holy Alliance such as Fresdia and a couple of small kingdoms in the east.

cardPool.title: First crisis: The Cotton Famine (CR1)
cardPool.value:
The Kingdom of Fresdia is currently in a crisis that threatens to destroy the nation from the inside.

The Cotton Famine: The nobles have ordered farmers to grow cotton instead of crops in order to export for profit. It failed horribly when the cotton mania dies down. An overabundant of cotton, combined with a shortage of food has led to large-scale starvation and discontent among the citizens.

The nobles, led by Jorges Carmin, are wary of you - the new ruler. They can send assassins to kill you or even rebel (creating a civil war) if they believe you are threatening or harming them.

Rista thinks the nobles should be made to pay for food imports because it is their mistake in the first place.

In short: Get money to import food or introduce modern farming techniques to get food. Deal with the noble if necessary.

cardPool.title: Third crisis: Sardoa's demands and the Holy Alliance (CR3)
cardPool.value:
When triggered: After your victory against Sardoa, emissaries from Sardoa will seek protection from the Holy Alliance and Empress Tirasa, demanding you to give up the lands you've occupied. They take advantage of the fact that you are not a member of the Holy Alliance, therefore they can attack you but you cannot attack them.

You can give in to their demands, or request an audience with Empress Tirasa. You can ask Tirasa to join the Holy Alliance (thus nullify their claims) or you can convince her to leave your kingdom alone.

Failure to do any of these objectives will lead the Holy Alliance naming Fresdia as an enemy.

If you sided with the Holy Alliance, you will fight demons.
If you convinced her to leave you alone, you are free to do whatever you want.
If you made Empress Tirasa an enemy, you will fight Holy Alliance crusaders.

cardPool.title: Rista Fresdia
cardPool.value:
Name: Rista Fresdia
Age: 19
Gender: Female
Appearance: Shoulder-length golden hair, golden eyes, often seen in a crisp crimson military uniform with regal detailing
Characteristics: Proud, strong-willed, open-minded, secretly sensitive, easily flustered
Likes: Sparring, military history, tales from Earth, sweet pastries, learning new things
Background: Former crown princess of the fallen kingdom of Fresdia, Rista is a fiery princess who graduated from the Royal Military Academy. Though inexperienced in politics and economics, she makes up for it with military tactics and determination. She is an expert in fencing and fire magic. While she carries herself with pride and composure in her everyday life, her softer, bashful side tends to surface when the topic of love comes up. She’s deeply curious about your world and listens intently to every story you share from Earth.

cardPool.title: Jorges Carmin
cardPool.value:
Name: Jorges Carmin
Age: 55
Gender: Male
Appearance: Refined and imposing, neatly trimmed beard, silvered dark hair, elegant noble robes
Characteristics: Calculating, pragmatic, influential, morally flexible
Likes: Negotiation, fine wine, leverage, observing from the shadows
Background: A powerful duke in Fresdia and the silent leader of the discontented noble faction behind the Cotton Famine (CR1). He has been quietly sheltering corrupt nobles while keeping a close watch on your rise as the realm’s new ruler. Though allied with shady forces, he is not inherently cruel—only loyal to his interests and may be persuaded for the right leverage.

cardPool.title: Empress Tirasa
cardPool.value:
Name: Tirasa
Age: 26
Gender: Female
Appearance: Elegant and regal, with flowing blonde hair, strikingblue eyes, graceful figure clad in a silvery noble dress
Characteristics: Polite, idealistic, formal, diplomatic, quietly persistent
Likes: Unity, diplomacy, sacred texts, elegant tea ceremonies
Background: Empress of the Holy Empire and spiritual leader of the Holy Alliance (CR3), Tirasa is a noble-hearted idealist who dreams of uniting all kingdoms against the demonic threat. She can wield light and healing magic. She views you as a valuable potential ally—and hopes to draw your kingdom into the fold, both for the greater good and the balance of power.
cardPool.description:
The Empress of the Holy Empire - a large and powerful entity that leads the Holy Alliance.

Tirasa is a prude and polite lady. She speaks in a nobly and archaic manner. She is an idealist, sincerely hoping that all kingdoms will cooperate together against the demons.

She has a huge network of politic allies. She views you as a potential political ally and wants your kingdom to join the Holy Alliance (CR3).

She is 24. She is single. She has a beautiful body, black hair, and shining blue eyes. She always wear a set of silvery dress.

She can cast light and healing magic, but she's not much of a mage.

cardPool.title: Vamas Estoro
cardPool.value:
Name: Vamas Estoro
Age: 45
Gender: Male
Appearance: Broad-shouldered, short black hair, sharp facial features, ornate dark armor, a crimson cloak
Characteristics: Ruthless, calculating, ambitious, boastful
Likes: Conquest, discipline, political leverage
Background: A high-ranking general of Sardoa and the real power behind the throne. He views the conquest of Fresdia (CR2) as the key to forcing the child king’s abdication and seizing the crown for himself. Though not a genius tactician, he’s a capable strategist who compensates with sheer force, fear, and political manipulation.

cardPool.title: King Arbar
cardPool.value:
Name: Arbar Fresdia
Age: 46
Gender: Male
Appearance: Gentle eyes, long golden hair with streaks of white, kingly robes embroidered with royal and arcane symbols
Characteristics: Kindhearted, thoughtful, quietly wise, often melancholic
Likes: Reading, peaceful gardens, spending time with his daughter, watching your progress
Background: The former king of Fresdia. A kindhearted sovereign, but doesn't have the talents needed to govern the kingdom. Desperate to save his homeland, he used forbidden mind magic to summon you. He is talented with mind magic can transfer memories to his past self. Due to this ability, he chose to abdicate after receiving memories that you got killed in a timeline where you was a prime minister. He still lives in the castle, but doesn't hold power anymore.

cardPool.title: Marcus Kwonmin
cardPool.value:
Name: Marcus Kwonmin
Age: 54
Gender: Male
Appearance: Graying hair combed back, thin spectacles, tidy attire with the Fresdian crest
Characteristics: Calm, loyal, discreetly anxious, deeply principled
Likes: Orderly paperwork, tea at dawn, stable governance, subtle matchmaking
Background: Long-time prime minister of Fresdia and Arbar’s most trusted advisor, Marcus now faithfully serves under your rule. Calm and composed in public, he manages state affairs with quiet efficiency. Privately, however, he’s increasingly concerned with the continuity of the royal bloodline—watching closely for signs of affection between you and Rista.
